material.title: Making Social Contact in the UK — short-answer questions
material.source_version: IELTS Sample Tasks 2023; isolated prompt excerpt

verification.method: Exact official PDF checksum matched source version; prompt p11, transcript p12 and key p13 read; prompt excerpt reopened and visually rendered; no answer pages copied.
verification.audio_verification: Official recording link inspected in exact source PDF p12; official CDN HTTP 200 audio/mpeg; downloaded ID3+MP3 parsed by afinfo without playback

freshness.basis: PROFILE.md, PROGRESS.md and AUDIT.md read on 2026-10-12; no recorded attempt/exposure for this task. Confirm learner has not seen key at session start.

material.delivery: Give local prompt-only PDF and local audio; Tata presses Play herself. Withhold full source PDF, key and transcript until done. Check playback support on the learning laptop without starting recording for Tata.

result_collection.primary: At initial attempt, learner answers directly in chat numbered 11–16, or writes on paper and sends a photo/screenshot. Never ask to retype all answers after done.

difficulty.note: No official band or difficulty assigned to this extract.

suggested_session.coach_timing_estimate: 2 minutes instructions, 1 minute scan, about 1 minute 33 seconds one play, 2 minutes finish/capture, 10 minutes feedback and one correction, remainder next action
suggested_session.score_policy: Report /6 only; no IELTS band. Respect order-independent pairs exactly as key p13 permits; count play from learner report, coach never starts it.

coach_reference.content: exact key and transcript/passage excerpts; never attach in learner instructions
